issue.title: Fix handling of multiple buckets being emitted for the same parent doc id in nested aggregation

labels.description: Search-related issues that do not fall into other categories

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
This bug was introduced by #8454 which allowed the childFilter to only be consumed once. By adding the child docid buffering multiple buckets can now be emitted by the same doc id. This child docid buffering only happens in the score of the current root document, so the amount of child doc ids buffered is small.

Closes #9317
